title: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Command Melding Reference

legend.recipe_types: A-P determine which ability each crystal attaches.
legend.shotlocks: Abilities cannot be attached when the meld yields a Shotlock.
legend.recipe_items: An in-game Recipe item is not required to meld; it only reveals the expected result in the menu.

footnote_rules.1: Normal result becomes 100% after obtaining Meteor Shower.
footnote_rules.2: Normal result becomes 100% after obtaining Lightning Ray.
footnote_rules.3: Normal result becomes 100% after obtaining Bio Barrage.
footnote_rules.4: Rare Bio Barrage result becomes 0% after Bio Barrage has been obtained.
footnote_rules.5: Rare Lightning Ray result becomes 0% after Lightning Ray has been obtained.
footnote_rules.6: Rare Meteor Shower result becomes 0% after Meteor Shower has been obtained.
